description: Move a scene through the explicit structure workflow. Writes canonical SQLite chapter linkage and/or timeline_position first, then mirrors compatibility fields to the scene sidecar and index; it does not move, rename, or resequence scene files or Scrivener-compatible folders.

chapter_id.description: Optional canonical chapter identifier. Use list_chapters to find valid values. Omit to keep the current chapter.

timeline_position.description: Optional new position within the target chapter. Must be unused.

name: move_scene
